name: rust-analyzer
summary: AI tools are allowed with a human in the loop who understands the work; autonomous agents may not open PRs or issues, and AI may not write code for E-easy issues with instructions. Issues, PR bodies and comments must be in your own words; quoted AI context must be disclosed. Disclosure of AI use is requested.

evidence.quote: We allow using AI (i.e., LLMs) as tools for contributing to rust-analyzer.
We do not allow autonomous agents to be used to open pull requests or issues to our projects.
AI should not be used to author code for E-easy+E-has-instructions issues.
If you are opening an issue, we expect you to describe the problem in your own words.
AI should not be used to generate comments when communicating with maintainers.
If you wish to include context from an interaction with AI in your comments, it must be in a quote block (e.g., using `>`) and disclosed as such.
